root_idea.summary: The root centers on breaking, falling, and loss of integrity, extending to perishing, death, ruin, destruction, and perdition.
root_idea.development: The basic notion of falling or collapse develops into becoming nonexistent or ruined, dying, causing destruction, and describing things or circumstances that lead to perdition.

senses.usage_conditions: Intransitive Form I usage referring to a person’s death or passing away.

senses.definition: To perish, be destroyed, come to an end, or cease to be.
senses.usage_conditions: Intransitive usage for a person or thing that perishes or is brought to an end; this is distinct from the causative Form IV meaning.

senses.definition: To be gone or lost from someone while still existing elsewhere.
senses.usage_conditions: A loss or absence construction, as in the Quranic expression for something being gone from a person although not annihilated.

senses.definition: To destroy, cause to perish, bring to an end, ruin, or take away life.
senses.usage_conditions: Transitive causative usage for people, communities, crops, or other things; Quranic contexts include destruction, death, corruption, and ruin, including the destruction of a people or generation and the bringing about of perdition.

senses.definition: Dead or dying; one who has perished.
senses.usage_conditions: Active participial description of a person who is dead or in the process of dying.

senses.definition: Subject to perish; destined to pass away.
senses.usage_conditions: Predicative or attributive use for what is liable to perish or cease to exist, including the Quranic statement that everything is perishable except God’s face.

senses.definition: Destruction or perishing; the event of being destroyed.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in constructions referring to the destruction or perishing of persons or a people, including possessive and genitive constructions.
Passive participial description of those who have been brought to ruin or destruction.

senses.definition: One who destroys or causes others to perish.
senses.usage_conditions: Active participial description of the agent responsible for destruction or ruin.

senses.definition: What leads to destruction; a cause or course of ruin.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for an action, condition, or course that brings about perdition or destruction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fall; to become bad, corrupt, vitiated, marred, or spoiled; or to go away so that none knows where.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Broader Form I uses describing collapse, deterioration, or disappearance, apart from the Quran-attested uses of dying, perishing, or being gone from someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of land, to have its herbage dry up through drought.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use with land as the subject.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A valley described as misleading or causing one to go astray.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Fixed expression for a named or characterized valley.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be vehemently eager for something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the construction تَهَالَكَ عَلَيْهِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To strive, toil, exert oneself, and hasten in an activity or affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with فِي for strenuous exertion in running or another matter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a she-camel, to vehemently desire the stallion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of a female camel’s sexual desire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek or court destruction; to risk oneself as one bent on death.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form X usage comparable to اِسْتَمَاتَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To distress, trouble, or fatigue oneself concerning something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the construction اِسْتَهْلَكَ فِي كَذَا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The drying up of plants or herbage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for the condition produced by drought.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Perdition, destruction, a lost state, or death.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun may also be used of punishment, fear, or poverty and in expressions for being caught in situations of perdition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Destruction or the act of causing destruction.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun described as equivalent to إهلاك.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cause of perdition or death.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used for something that brings about ruin or death.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place of perdition or death, especially a desert in which people perish.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or place-name use based on the danger of the locality.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who courts destruction or is bent on risking death.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression هُوَ مُسْتَهْلِكٌ إِلَى كَذَا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A road that destroys the person seeking water because of its great distance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic description of a dangerously long route to water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman who moves with languorous, broken or swaying gait; figuratively, a wanton woman.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The figurative sense derives from the manner of her swaying.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A blacksmith; a person belonging by attribution to Hālik, the eponym associated with the craft.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nisbah usage, extended to blacksmiths generally.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing that is perishing or has perished.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use describing the thing itself as ruined or perished.
